description: Defines the rx::ImageD3D class, an abstract base class for renderer-specific classes managing D3D images and surfaces, including interface methods for loading data, setting surfaces, and copying data.

classes.name: ImageD3D
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D image and surface management, providing interface for loading, copying, and managing surface states.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the image.

methods.name: getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the image.

methods.name: isRenderableFormat
methods.description: Checks if the format is renderable.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the image is dirty (abstract).

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the image with new type, format, size, and optional release.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data into the image from the provided context and area.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed data into the image.

methods.name: setManagedSurface2D
methods.description: Sets a 2D surface as managed surface.

methods.name: setManagedSurfaceCube
methods.description: Sets a cube face surface as managed surface.

methods.name: setManagedSurface3D
methods.description: Sets a 3D surface as managed surface.

methods.name: setManagedSurface2DArray
methods.description: Sets a 2D array surface as managed surface.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies image data to a texture storage.

methods.name: copyFromTexStorage
methods.description: Copies data from texture storage to the image.

methods.name: copyFromFramebuffer
methods.description: Copies data from framebuffer to the image.
